📸 LIVE: An LLM-assisted Multi-Image Visual Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark
	


Welcome to the LIVE dataset! This benchmark is designed to evaluate multi-image visual hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). 

	
		
		🌟 Key Features
	

Unlike traditional single-image benchmarks, LIVE systematically addresses the complexities of multi-image understanding:

Two Distinct Scenarios: Evaluates context-dependent hallucination patterns under Uniform Image Contexts (UIC)… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tong613/LIVE-multi-image-bench.
reputation: An emerging Hugging Face benchmark for multi-image LVLM hallucination evaluation, gaining attention in recent robustness and alignment studies.
